context: A boss reviews a corporate medical-CSR program
purpose: Teach: 麻酔/化石/慢性/申し立て/賞賛/予期/偏っ/迄

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員健康診断、麻酔含む手術歴のフォローを徹底させろ。
lines.en: Staff health screenings — I want strict follow-up on any surgical history involving anesthesia.
lines.style: Measured, authoritative opening. Crisp cadence on key terms. No room for interpretation. Embedded expectation that this will be done.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。慢性疾患の対象者、化石的なシステムからリニューアル中です。
lines.en: Understood. We're transitioning the chronic-disease tracking out of the old system now.
lines.style: Respectful confirmation with subtle confidence. Steady, procedural rhythm. Shows progress already underway without overselling.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 労災申し立て、過去の事例、適切に処理しろ。
lines.en: Workplace-injury claims — make sure past cases are handled correctly.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Slight weight on 「properly」— not accusing, but clarifying the standard. Expects alignment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 制度改正への賞賛、メディアからも届いています。
lines.en: The reforms have actually gotten media attention — positive coverage.
lines.style: Slightly warmer than before. Brings good news with understated pride. Tone lifts slightly as he shares success without seeking praise.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 予期せぬ事象、データが偏った時期の検証も、年度末迄に。
lines.en: Any anomalies, data audits from periods with skewed results — all wrapped up by year-end.
lines.style: Final directive. Deliberate, unhurried. Each clause lands with quiet weight. No negotiation. Closes the conversation with composed certainty.
